dialog.title: Download {{title}}
dialog.description: Send this release to a download client. The destination is a category of the client, and the category decides the folder.

optionsFailed: Could not load the download clients.
optionsRefreshFailed: Could not load the download clients again, showing the last loaded ones.
noClients: No download client can take this release yet. The owner sets them up under Integrations and Destinations.

summary.title: Summary
summary.kept: Kept: this version of the app never replaces or removes a file, and doesn't send a release it finds would write over a different one.

overwrite.NotCheckedFolderUnknown: The app can't check whether this release would write over a file already there: the destination's folder has no path in the app, or its download client can't say where it is. A release sent there goes without that check.
overwrite.NotCheckedFolderOutsideMediaFolders: The app can't check whether this release would write over a file already there: the destination's folder isn't under Media folders, which the installation owner sets in the user menu. A release sent there goes without that check.

pickFirst: Pick a download client and a destination first.

outcome.Created: This release is already being sent to {{client}}. Its outcome isn't known yet.
outcome.Submitted: {{client}} took the release and lists it among its downloads.
outcome.SubmittedUnlisted: {{client}} took the release, but hasn't listed it among its downloads yet.
outcome.Paused: {{client}} took the release, but its download is paused there.
outcome.NeedsLinking: {{client}} took the release, but the app can't tell which of its downloads it is, so it has to be linked by hand.
outcome.Cancelled: {{client}} took the release, but its job has been cancelled since, so the app doesn't follow it.
